column2:
racism(n.)種族歧視、種族主義
racist(n./adj.)種族主義者、種族歧視的
fight racism 對抗種族歧視
institutional racism 制度性種族歧視
Many athletes have spoken out publicly against racism in sports.
(許多運動員公開發聲反對體壇的種族歧視。)
The school held a workshop to help students understand the harm of racism.
(學校舉辦了一場工作坊，幫助學生了解種族歧視的危害。)

rack(n./v.)架子、使痛苦
(無詞性變化)
shoe rack 鞋架
rack one's brain 絞盡腦汁
He hung his wet towel on the rack in the bathroom.
(他把濕毛巾掛在浴室的架子上。)
I racked my brain but couldn't remember her name.
(我絞盡腦汁還是想不起她的名字。)

radiation(n.)輻射、放射線
radiate(v.)散發、輻射
radioactive(adj.)放射性的
radiation exposure 輻射暴露
nuclear radiation 核輻射
Long exposure to radiation can seriously damage human cells.
(長時間暴露在輻射下會嚴重損害人體細胞。)
Sunscreen protects your skin from harmful ultraviolet radiation.
(防曬乳能保護皮膚免受有害紫外線輻射。)

radical(adj./n.)根本的、激進的、激進分子
radically(adv.)徹底地
radical change 根本的改變
radical ideas 激進的想法
The new principal made radical changes to the school schedule.
(新校長對學校的作息做了根本性的改變。)
Some of his political views are considered too radical.
(他的一些政治觀點被認為太過激進。)

ragged(adj.)破爛的、衣衫襤褸的、參差不齊的
rag(n.)破布
ragged clothes 破爛的衣服
ragged edge 參差不齊的邊緣
The child in ragged clothes was begging for food.
(那個衣衫襤褸的孩子正在乞討食物。)
After running ten kilometers, his breathing was ragged.
(跑完十公里後，他的呼吸變得急促不穩。)

raid(n./v.)突襲、搜捕、劫掠
raider(n.)襲擊者
police raid 警方突襲搜查
air raid 空襲
Police carried out a raid on the illegal gambling house.
(警方突襲搜查了那間非法賭場。)
The kids raided the fridge as soon as they got home.
(孩子們一回到家就把冰箱搜刮一空。)

rail(n.)欄杆、鐵軌、鐵路
railing(n.)欄杆
high-speed rail 高速鐵路
by rail 搭火車
Taking the high-speed rail from Taipei to Kaohsiung saves a lot of time.
(從台北搭高鐵到高雄可以省下很多時間。)
Hold onto the rail when you walk down the stairs.
(下樓梯時請抓住扶手。)

rally(n./v.)集會、重整、號召、(網球)對打
(無詞性變化)
hold a rally 舉行集會
rally support 爭取支持
Thousands of people attended the rally for climate action.
(數千人參加了支持氣候行動的集會。)
The captain rallied his teammates after they fell behind.
(落後之後，隊長重新激勵隊友士氣。)

ranch(n./v.)大農場、牧場、經營牧場
rancher(n.)牧場主人
cattle ranch 養牛場
ranch house 牧場式平房
His family owns a large cattle ranch in Texas.
(他的家族在德州擁有一座大型養牛場。)
We spent the summer riding horses on a ranch.
(我們在一座牧場騎馬度過了夏天。)

random(adj.)隨機的、任意的
randomly(adv.)隨機地
at random 隨機地
random sample 隨機樣本
The teacher picked three students at random to answer the question.
(老師隨機挑了三位學生回答問題。)
The researchers interviewed a random sample of 500 teenagers.
(研究人員訪問了五百名隨機抽樣的青少年。)

ratio(n.)比例、比率
(無詞性變化)
the ratio of A to B 兩者的比例
student-teacher ratio 師生比
The ratio of boys to girls in our class is about two to one.
(我們班男女生的比例大約是二比一。)
Smaller classes have a lower student-teacher ratio.
(小班制的師生比較低。)

rational(adj.)理性的、合理的
rationality(n.)理性
rationally(adv.)理性地
rational decision 理性的決定
rational thinking 理性思考
Try to stay calm and make a rational decision.
(試著保持冷靜，做出理性的決定。)
There must be a rational explanation for what happened.
(發生的事情一定有合理的解釋。)

rattle(v./n.)發出咯咯聲、使慌張、波浪鼓
(無詞性變化)
rattle the windows 使窗戶咯咯作響
baby rattle 嬰兒搖鈴
The strong wind rattled the windows all night.
(強風整晚吹得窗戶咯咯作響。)
She was rattled by the difficult interview questions.
(她被那些困難的面試問題弄得心慌意亂。)

realism(n.)現實主義、寫實主義
realist(n.)現實主義者
realistic(adj.)實際的、逼真的
a sense of realism 現實感
artistic realism 藝術寫實主義
The film is praised for its realism in depicting war.
(這部電影因描繪戰爭的寫實而受到讚揚。)
Her plan shows a healthy dose of realism.
(她的計畫展現出相當程度的務實。)

realm(n.)領域、範圍、王國
(無詞性變化)
within the realm of possibility 在可能範圍內
the realm of science 科學領域
Traveling to Mars is now within the realm of possibility.
(前往火星現在已經在可能的範圍內。)
Her research opened up a new realm of study.
(她的研究開拓了一個新的研究領域。)

rear(adj./n.)後面的、後部、養育
(無詞性變化)
rear seat 後座
rear a child 養育孩子
Please use the rear door when getting off the bus.
(下公車時請走後門。)
She reared three children on her own.
(她獨自養大了三個孩子。)

reassure(v.)使安心、消除疑慮
reassurance(n.)安慰、保證
reassuring(adj.)令人安心的
reassure sb. that 向某人保證…
reassuring smile 令人安心的微笑
The doctor reassured me that the surgery would go well.
(醫生向我保證手術會很順利。)
Her calm voice was reassuring to the nervous students.
(她平靜的聲音讓緊張的學生安心不少。)

rebellion(n.)叛亂、反抗
rebel(n./v.)叛亂者、反抗
rebellious(adj.)叛逆的
armed rebellion 武裝叛亂
teenage rebellion 青少年叛逆
The government sent troops to put down the rebellion.
(政府派兵鎮壓叛亂。)
Dyeing his hair green was a small act of teenage rebellion.
(把頭髮染成綠色是他小小的青春期叛逆行為。)

recession(n.)經濟衰退、後退
recede(v.)後退、減弱
economic recession 經濟衰退
in recession 處於衰退中
Many people lost their jobs during the economic recession.
(經濟衰退期間許多人失去了工作。)
Experts warn that the country may slip into a recession.
(專家警告這個國家可能陷入經濟衰退。)

recipient(n./adj.)接受者、領受者、接受的
receive(v.)接受、收到
award recipient 得獎者
organ recipient 器官受贈者
She was the youngest recipient of the science award.
(她是那個科學獎最年輕的得主。)
The recipient of the letter never replied.
(收信人從未回覆。)

recite(v.)背誦、朗誦、列舉
recitation(n.)背誦
recital(n.)獨奏會、獨唱會
recite a poem 朗誦詩
recite from memory 憑記憶背誦
Each student had to recite a poem in front of the class.
(每位學生都得在全班面前朗誦一首詩。)
He recited the whole speech from memory.
(他憑記憶背出整篇演講。)

recommend(v.)推薦、建議
recommendation(n.)推薦、建議
highly recommend 強力推薦
recommend that 建議…
I highly recommend this book to anyone interested in history.
(我強力推薦這本書給對歷史有興趣的人。)
The doctor recommended that he get more sleep.
(醫生建議他多睡一點。)

recommendation(n.)推薦、建議、推薦信
recommend(v.)推薦、建議
letter of recommendation 推薦信
make a recommendation 提出建議
I asked my teacher to write a letter of recommendation for me.
(我請老師幫我寫一封推薦信。)
We chose this restaurant on a friend's recommendation.
(我們依照朋友的推薦選了這間餐廳。)

recruit(v./n.)招募、新成員、新兵
recruitment(n.)招募
recruit volunteers 招募志工
new recruit 新成員
The club is recruiting new members this week.
(社團這週正在招募新社員。)
The new recruits trained hard for three months.
(新兵們刻苦訓練了三個月。)

refuge(n.)避難、庇護所
refugee(n.)難民
take refuge 避難
wildlife refuge 野生動物保護區
The hikers took refuge in a cave during the storm.
(登山客在暴風雨中躲進山洞避難。)
For her, the library was a quiet refuge from the busy city.
(對她來說，圖書館是遠離喧囂城市的寧靜避風港。)

regardless(adj./adv.)不管、不顧
(無詞性變化)
regardless of 不論…
regardless of the cost 不惜代價
Everyone is welcome to join, regardless of age or background.
(不論年齡或背景，歡迎所有人加入。)
It was raining hard, but they went ahead regardless.
(雨下得很大，但他們仍不顧一切照常進行。)

regime(n.)政權、政體、制度
(無詞性變化)
military regime 軍事政權
political regime 政治體制
The country suffered for decades under a military regime.
(那個國家在軍事政權統治下受苦了數十年。)
The old regime collapsed after massive protests.
(舊政權在大規模抗議後垮台。)

rehearsal(n.)排練、預演
rehearse(v.)排練
dress rehearsal 彩排
in rehearsal 排練中
The band had a final rehearsal before the concert.
(樂團在演唱會前做了最後一次排練。)
The dress rehearsal went smoothly last night.
(昨晚的彩排進行得很順利。)

reinforce(v.)加強、強化、增援
reinforcement(n.)強化、增援
reinforce learning 強化學習
reinforced concrete 鋼筋混凝土
Regular review helps reinforce what you learned in class.
(定期複習有助於加強課堂所學。)
The bridge was reinforced with steel after the earthquake.
(地震後這座橋以鋼材加以補強。)

reminder(n.)提醒、提醒物
remind(v.)提醒、使想起
gentle reminder 溫馨提醒
serve as a reminder 作為提醒
This is a gentle reminder that the report is due on Friday.
(溫馨提醒，報告星期五截止。)
The old photo serves as a reminder of our happy childhood.
(這張舊照片讓人想起我們快樂的童年。)

removal(n.)移除、除去、搬遷
remove(v.)移除、拿走
snow removal 除雪
hair removal 除毛
The removal of the old tree took the workers all day.
(工人們花了一整天才移除那棵老樹。)
The city is responsible for garbage removal in this area.
(市政府負責這個區域的垃圾清運。)

render(v.)使成為、給予、表現、翻譯
rendering(n.)表演、詮釋
render sb. helpless 使某人無助
render assistance 提供協助
The heavy snow rendered the roads impassable.
(大雪使道路無法通行。)
Volunteers rendered help to the flood victims.
(志工們為水災災民提供協助。)

rental(n.)租金、出租、租賃
rent(v./n.)租、租金
car rental 租車
rental apartment 出租公寓
We arranged a car rental for our trip to Hualien.
(我們為花蓮之旅安排了租車。)
Monthly rental for apartments near the university is high.
(大學附近公寓的月租金很高。)

repay(v.)償還、報答
repayment(n.)償還
repay a loan 償還貸款
repay kindness 報答恩情
It took him five years to repay the loan.
(他花了五年才還清貸款。)
How can I ever repay your kindness?
(我要怎麼報答你的恩情呢？)

republican(n./adj.)共和主義者、共和黨員、共和國的
republic(n.)共和國
Republican Party 美國共和黨
republican government 共和政府
He has voted for the Republican candidate in every election.
(他每次選舉都投給共和黨候選人。)
The country adopted a republican form of government in 1912.
(這個國家在一九一二年採行共和政體。)

resemblance(n.)相似、相像
resemble(v.)像、與…相似
bear a resemblance to 和…相像
strong resemblance 非常相像
She bears a strong resemblance to her grandmother.
(她和她祖母長得非常像。)
The story bears little resemblance to what actually happened.
(這個故事和實際發生的事幾乎沒有相似之處。)

reservoir(n.)水庫、蓄水池、儲藏
(無詞性變化)
water reservoir 水庫
Feitsui Reservoir 翡翠水庫
The water level in the reservoir dropped sharply during the drought.
(乾旱期間水庫水位急遽下降。)
Feitsui Reservoir supplies water to most of Taipei.
(翡翠水庫供應台北大部分地區的用水。)

residence(n.)住所、居住
reside(v.)居住
residential(adj.)住宅的
permanent residence 永久居留
official residence 官邸
The president's official residence is heavily guarded.
(總統官邸戒備森嚴。)
He has taken up residence in Tainan since he retired.
(他退休後就定居在台南。)

resident(n./adj.)居民、住院醫師、居住的
reside(v.)居住
local residents 當地居民
resident doctor 住院醫師
Local residents complained about the noise from the construction.
(當地居民抱怨施工的噪音。)
She has been a resident of this town for twenty years.
(她在這個小鎮住了二十年。)

residential(adj.)住宅的、居住的
residence(n.)住所
residential area 住宅區
residential building 住宅大樓
Factories are not allowed in residential areas.
(住宅區內不准設工廠。)
The new residential building has thirty floors.
(那棟新住宅大樓有三十層。)

resort(n./v.)度假勝地、手段、訴諸
(無詞性變化)
beach resort 海灘度假村
last resort 最後手段
We stayed at a beach resort in Kenting.
(我們住在墾丁的一間海灘度假村。)
Parents should never resort to violence to discipline their children.
(父母絕不應該用暴力管教孩子。)

respondent(n.)回答者、受訪者、被告
respond(v.)回應
response(n.)回應
survey respondent 問卷受訪者
majority of respondents 多數受訪者
Most respondents said they spend over three hours a day online.
(大多數受訪者表示每天上網超過三小時。)
The survey asked respondents about their sleep habits.
(這份調查詢問受訪者的睡眠習慣。)

resume(v./n.)重新開始、繼續、履歷
resume(n.)履歷(亦作résumé)
resume work 恢復工作
send a résumé 寄履歷
Classes will resume after the typhoon passes.
(颱風過後將恢復上課。)
She sent her résumé to five companies.
(她把履歷寄給了五家公司。)

retail(n./adj./adv./v.)零售、零售的、以零售方式、零售
retailer(n.)零售商
retail price 零售價
retail store 零售店
The retail price of this phone is higher than I expected.
(這支手機的零售價比我預期的高。)
Online shopping has changed the retail industry dramatically.
(網路購物大幅改變了零售業。)

revenue(n.)收入、稅收
(無詞性變化)
tax revenue 稅收
advertising revenue 廣告收入
Tourism is a major source of revenue for the island.
(觀光是這座島嶼的主要收入來源。)
The company's revenue increased by twenty percent last year.
(這家公司去年營收成長了百分之二十。)

reverse(v./adj./n.)反轉、倒退、相反的、相反
reversal(n.)反轉
reversible(adj.)可逆的、可兩面穿的
in reverse 倒過來、反向
reverse the decision 推翻決定
The court reversed its earlier decision.
(法院推翻了先前的判決。)
Read the numbers in reverse order.
(把這些數字倒著唸。)

rhetoric(n.)修辭、修辭學、華麗空洞的言詞
rhetorical(adj.)修辭的
political rhetoric 政治辭令
empty rhetoric 空話
Voters are tired of empty political rhetoric.
(選民厭倦了空洞的政治辭令。)
The speech was full of rhetoric but lacked real solutions.
(那篇演講充滿華麗辭藻，卻缺乏實際解決方案。)

rib(n./v.)肋骨、排骨、取笑
(無詞性變化)
broken rib 肋骨斷裂
pork ribs 豬肋排
He broke two ribs in the car accident.
(他在車禍中斷了兩根肋骨。)
We ordered grilled pork ribs for dinner.
(我們晚餐點了烤豬肋排。)

ridge(n./v.)山脊、隆起、使隆起
(無詞性變化)
mountain ridge 山脊
walk along the ridge 沿著山脊走
We hiked along the ridge and enjoyed the view.
(我們沿著山脊健行，欣賞風景。)
The sun rose slowly over the distant ridge.
(太陽從遠方的山脊緩緩升起。)

ridiculous(adj.)荒謬的、可笑的
ridicule(v./n.)嘲笑
ridiculously(adv.)荒謬地
ridiculous idea 荒謬的想法
look ridiculous 看起來很可笑
It's ridiculous to pay that much for a T-shirt.
(花那麼多錢買一件T恤太荒謬了。)
I felt ridiculous in that bright pink costume.
(穿著那套亮粉紅色的戲服我覺得很可笑。)

rifle(n./v.)步槍、翻找
(無詞性變化)
hunting rifle 獵槍
rifle through 翻找
The soldier cleaned his rifle carefully.
(那名士兵仔細清理他的步槍。)
She rifled through her bag looking for her keys.
(她在包包裡翻找鑰匙。)

rigid(adj.)嚴格的、死板的、堅硬的
rigidity(n.)嚴格、僵硬
rigidly(adv.)嚴格地
rigid rules 死板的規定
rigid structure 堅固的結構
The school's rigid rules left students little freedom.
(學校死板的規定讓學生幾乎沒有自由。)
The box is made of rigid plastic.
(這個盒子是用硬塑膠做的。)

rim(n./v.)邊緣、框、圍繞
(無詞性變化)
the rim of a cup 杯緣
glasses rim 眼鏡框
The ball rolled around the rim before dropping into the basket.
(球在籃框上滾了一圈才掉進籃裡。)
Salt was added to the rim of the glass.
(杯緣上沾了一圈鹽。)

riot(n./v.)暴動、騷亂、發生暴動
riotous(adj.)暴亂的、喧鬧的
riot police 鎮暴警察
start a riot 引發暴動
Riot police were sent to control the angry crowd.
(鎮暴警察被派去控制憤怒的群眾。)
Prisoners rioted over the poor living conditions.
(囚犯因惡劣的生活條件而發生暴動。)

rip(v./n.)撕裂、扯破、裂口
(無詞性變化)
rip off 敲竹槓、剝削
rip open 撕開
He ripped open the envelope to read the letter.
(他撕開信封讀信。)
Paying 500 dollars for that coffee was a total rip-off.
(那杯咖啡要五百元，根本是敲竹槓。)

risky(adj.)危險的、冒險的
risk(n./v.)風險、冒…的險
risky business 冒險的事
risky decision 冒險的決定
Swimming in the river after heavy rain is very risky.
(大雨後在河裡游泳非常危險。)
Investing all your money in one stock is a risky decision.
(把所有錢都投資在一支股票上是冒險的決定。)

ritual(n./adj.)儀式、例行習慣、儀式的
(無詞性變化)
religious ritual 宗教儀式
daily ritual 每日例行習慣
Making coffee in the morning is part of my daily ritual.
(早上煮咖啡是我每天的例行習慣。)
The temple holds a special ritual during the Ghost Festival.
(這間廟在中元節舉行特別的儀式。)

rival(adj./n./v.)競爭的、對手、與…匹敵
rivalry(n.)競爭、對抗
rival team 敵隊
main rival 主要對手
Our school beat its biggest rival in the final.
